chapterGroups.title: The Road
description: A chapter with no dependsOn in it at all. The order of the
quests list is the progression, because the chapter says so.

chapters.title: Desert Road
chapters.subtitle: Linear: the list order is the progression

quests.title: Sift the Sand
quests.subtitle: Sixteen, and you will stop counting
description: A tome-shaped node, and a name drawn under it.
Every quest in this chapter has a title drawn under it,
because this is the chapter that demonstrating names is for --
and the other two chapters do not, which is the default.

quests.title: Walls of a Kind
description: No dependsOn field. This quest unlocks when the one above
it in the list completes, because the chapter is linear.
Spelling that out as a dependsOn would have worked and would
have been the same thing said twice.

quests.title: Melt It Clear
description: A hexagon. The shape is only ever a drawing instruction,
and this is the chapter where all four appear together.

quests.title: Something Green
description: A circle, and the smallest node in the chapter.
A circle is a poor shape for a dense tree and a good one
for a landmark, which is what this is meant to be.
iconScale 0.6 with a size of 40 -- small node, small icon,
so this reads as a marker on the road rather than a stop.
The scale is a fraction of the largest square that fits,
so it composes with the size instead of overriding it.

quests.title: Trade the Glass
quests.subtitle: A trade, so it takes the panes
description: This task consumes -- four glass panes go into the trade and
do not come back. The chapter's defaultConsumeItems is false,
so the flag is on the task itself.
Handing this in needs the panes to really be in the inventory.
The Submit button checks, and so does the server.

quests.title: The Road Home
quests.subtitle: The last one, and the only checkmark
description: A checkmark at the end of a linear chapter, which is a
reasonable shape for "you got here": there is nothing to
check, because getting here was the check.
The book draws lines between consecutive quests in a linear
chapter, so the shape of the road is visible even though
nothing in this file declares a dependency.
iconScale 0.9: nearly full, because arriving somewhere is
worth an icon you can see.
